references.usage: the mountain's silhouette, camera angle, faceted rock shading and colouring — match this closely

args.description: A single rocky mountain peak on a transparent background, seen from high above at a steep angle. Faceted crags rising to one sharp summit, a pale snow-dusted cap, cool grey-blue stone with subtle warm and green mineral streaks in the rock faces, dark shadowed clefts. No ground, no grass, no sky.
